OWNERSHIP_SCOPE.purpose: Decide whether OpenKill owns this dataplane context before routing policy evaluation.

SAFETY_ACCESS.purpose: Protect control, underlay, local, reply, and access semantics before ordinary routing policy.

ROUTING_POLICY.purpose: Describe destination and user policy after ownership and safety facts are known.

BACKEND_ACTION.purpose: Translate one semantic decision into a selected backend capability without changing precedence.

OWNER_DISABLED.meaning: The active owner is not OpenKill, so this context is outside OpenKill classification.
OWNER_DISABLED.target_behavior: Ownership gate returns NOT_OWNED and fails closed for unknown ownership.

DNS.meaning: The packet belongs to a declared LAN or router DNS interception scope.
DNS.current_behavior: DNS is handled before ordinary policy.
DNS.target_behavior: DNS remains an independent special entry.

CONTROL_PROTOCOL.meaning: IPv6 control traffic required for native network operation.
CONTROL_PROTOCOL.current_behavior: Family-specific control rule is after service-port rules.
CONTROL_PROTOCOL.target_behavior: Control safety precedes access and routing policy.

SELF_TRAFFIC.meaning: Traffic generated by the OpenKill or Mihomo underlay process.
SELF_TRAFFIC.current_behavior: Self-process detection returns a native underlay bypass.
SELF_TRAFFIC.target_behavior: Self traffic remains a loop-prevention safety match.

TUN_INGRESS.meaning: Traffic returning from the OpenKill or Mihomo TUN interface.
TUN_INGRESS.current_behavior: IPv4 returns; IPv6 remains the documented current gap.
TUN_INGRESS.target_behavior: Both families return before routing policy.

NODE_ENDPOINT.meaning: The destination is an active proxy-node underlay endpoint.
NODE_ENDPOINT.current_behavior: Node endpoint set is returned to native underlay after custom access.
NODE_ENDPOINT.target_behavior: Node endpoint safety precedes ordinary access and routing policy.

LOCAL_DESTINATION.meaning: The destination is local topology: loopback, private, link-local, multicast, WAN host, LAN prefix, or delegated prefix.
LOCAL_DESTINATION.current_behavior: Local destination sets return to native handling.
LOCAL_DESTINATION.target_behavior: Local topology remains a safety bypass after underlay guards.

REPLY_TRAFFIC.meaning: An existing connection is in reply direction.
REPLY_TRAFFIC.current_behavior: Reply traffic returns before ordinary policy.
REPLY_TRAFFIC.target_behavior: Reply safety remains independent of user policy.

SERVICE_PORT.meaning: The packet matches a normalized OpenKill service-port safety set.
SERVICE_PORT.current_behavior: Service-port traffic is returned before policy routing.
SERVICE_PORT.target_behavior: Service-port safety remains separate from access port policy.

ACCESS_CONTROL.meaning: A normalized LAN, WAN, port, allow, bypass, or deny ACL fact matches.
ACCESS_CONTROL.current_behavior: The exact modern updater inserts NODE_ENDPOINT at position 0; custom access follows it. Generic ACL outcome is backend-dependent.
ACCESS_CONTROL.target_behavior: Access remains its own layer and cannot silently become user routing intent.

FAKEIP.meaning: The destination is inside a configured synthetic Fake-IP range.
FAKEIP.current_behavior: Fake-IP follows the proxy path after safety and access rules.
FAKEIP.target_behavior: Fake-IP proxy intent is protected from ordinary China policy.

EXPLICIT_DIRECT.meaning: The user explicitly requests native/direct routing for the destination.
EXPLICIT_DIRECT.current_behavior: The current production source does not fully expose this fact.
EXPLICIT_DIRECT.target_behavior: Explicit direct policy is evaluated before China/default policy.

EXPLICIT_PROXY.meaning: The user explicitly requests proxy routing for the destination.
EXPLICIT_PROXY.current_behavior: The current production source does not fully expose this fact.
EXPLICIT_PROXY.target_behavior: Explicit proxy policy is evaluated before China/default policy.

CHINA_PASS.meaning: The destination is excluded from the China direct set and follows the pass/fall-through policy.
CHINA_PASS.current_behavior: China-pass is recorded and falls through to the current default path.
CHINA_PASS.target_behavior: China-pass has an explicit proxy/fall-through semantic reason.

CHINA_POLICY.meaning: The destination matches the normalized China policy set.
CHINA_POLICY.current_behavior: China policy returns to native/direct handling.
CHINA_POLICY.target_behavior: China policy is evaluated after explicit user policy and Fake-IP.

DEFAULT_POLICY.current_behavior: Final policy marks or proxies ordinary traffic.
DEFAULT_POLICY.target_behavior: Default is reached only after all safety and explicit policy checks.

INVALID_CONFIGURATION.meaning: The context or policy combination is not part of the contract.
INVALID_CONFIGURATION.current_behavior: Reject invalid combinations rather than choosing a default.
INVALID_CONFIGURATION.target_behavior: Fail closed on invalid or unknown input.

notes: The exact modern node updater inserts NODE_ENDPOINT at position 0, ahead of custom access in the final chain.
TUN_INGRESS is implemented for IPv4; IPv6 remains the recorded current gap.
CHINA_PASS records a match and falls through to the current default behavior.
Explicit user direct/proxy mapping remains CURRENT_UNDEFINED where the oracle records it.
Target behavior is a development preview until each behavior change is approved independently.
Safety reasons precede routing policy; Fake-IP remains proxy intent below safety and above ordinary policy.
Target profile must never become the production default implicitly.

NOT_OWNED.meaning: OpenKill does not own this dataplane context.
NOT_OWNED.backend_requirement: Leave ownership to the active owner; never reinterpret as DIRECT.

BYPASS.meaning: Safety or topology bypass; use native/direct underlay semantics.

DIRECT.meaning: Routing policy explicitly selects native/direct handling.

PROXY.backend_requirement: Select an expressible proxy capability or report unsupported.

DNS_SPECIAL.meaning: DNS interception is handled by its declared scope.
DNS_SPECIAL.backend_requirement: Use DNS-specific action; do not reclassify through China/default policy.

ACCESS_DENY.backend_requirement: Report an explicit deny requirement; renderer chooses only an approved capability.

facts.name: LINK_LOCAL
facts.meaning: Link-local address used on the local link.

facts.name: WAN_HOST
facts.meaning: The router WAN interface host identity; IPv6 is host semantic equivalent to /128.

facts.name: DELEGATED_PREFIX
facts.meaning: A native delegated prefix assigned to the LAN.

local_destination_contract.rule: The adapter preserves the most specific fact; the classifier supplies precedence and the native/direct outcome.

fact_source_map.normalization: canonical hosts and prefixes; WAN IPv6 hosts are /128 semantic

fact_source_map.current_source: classifier fallback after all higher matches

renderer_input_contract.profile_rule: Production rendering defaults to current; target requires explicit approval outside this specification.
rules: Reject unknown versions and unknown profiles.
Reject missing or invalid semantic facts; do not convert UNKNOWN into DEFAULT_POLICY.
Translate the selected decision only; never recalculate precedence.
Preserve reason and status for diagnostics.
Report an unsupported backend capability explicitly rather than silently selecting DIRECT.

renderer_invariants.name: POLICY_INDEPENDENT
renderer_invariants.requirement: Renderer MUST NOT decide precedence or override classifier decision.

renderer_invariants.name: FAIL_CLOSED
renderer_invariants.requirement: Unknown schema, profile, enum, fact, or unsupported capability must reject or report unsupported.

renderer_invariants.name: OWNERSHIP_SCOPED_CLEANUP
renderer_invariants.requirement: Cleanup may remove only uniquely identified OpenKill-owned objects.

renderer_invariants.name: SINGLE_WRITER
renderer_invariants.requirement: Only Reconcile may mutate the OpenKill dataplane; watchdog observes or requests.

renderer_invariants.name: FAMILY_PARITY
renderer_invariants.requirement: PARITY_REQUIRED reasons preserve semantic reason/decision across IPv4 and IPv6.

renderer_invariants.name: BACKEND_PARITY
renderer_invariants.requirement: Modern and legacy backends preserve semantic outcomes even when capabilities differ.

renderer_invariants.name: NATIVE_IPV6_OWNERSHIP
renderer_invariants.requirement: OpenWrt/netifd retains native IPv6 addresses, PD, and source-specific routes.

renderer_invariants.name: NO_GENERIC_IPV6_DEFAULT
renderer_invariants.requirement: OpenKill must not create a generic native main-table IPv6 default.

renderer_invariants.name: NO_FOREIGN_FLUSH
renderer_invariants.requirement: Renderer must not flush or remove foreign backend objects.

renderer_invariants.name: DEFAULT_CURRENT
renderer_invariants.requirement: Production profile is current until explicit behavior approvals exist.

modern_legacy_parity.rule: Equivalent semantic reason and decision are required; syntax and capability reporting may differ.
modern_legacy_parity.unsupported_rule: A backend limitation must be reported, never silently converted to DIRECT.

family_parity.rule: Family-specific representation may differ, but no fictitious family mirror may be introduced.

static_dynamic_contract.rule: Dynamic changes are inputs to normalized desired state and component reconcile; they do not alter the semantic contract implicitly.

access_control_contract.rule: ACL action must not be silently converted into user routing intent.

dns_contract.rule: DNS scope and mode come from normalized state; ordinary China, user, or default policy must not decide interception.

underlay_contract.node_provider_rule: Provider endpoints enter NODE desired state; they do not create a new semantic reason.
underlay_contract.self_detector_rule: Process identity or future cgroup detection is a fact detector, not the semantic definition.
underlay_contract.last_known_good_rule: Node resolution failure retains last-known-good applied endpoints.
underlay_contract.single_owner_rule: OpenKill and Mihomo must not simultaneously own the same proxy dataplane.

snapshot_contract.meaning: Native network facts normalized once for desired-state construction.
must_exclude: proxy-owned TUN route as native semantic change
snapshot_contract.address_rule: WAN IPv6 interface addresses are host identities; internal delegated prefixes retain network CIDR semantics.
snapshot_contract.source_rule: OpenWrt/netifd remains the source of native addresses, PD, and source-specific routes.

custom_firewall_contract.rule: Custom firewall behavior must be explicitly isolated; the semantic classifier must not silently interpret arbitrary custom text.

phase_3_migration_policy.behavior_change_rule: Approve and roll out one BC record at a time after the preserving renderer is proven.

behavior_changes.current_behavior: Explicit user direct/proxy facts are partially unmapped; China/default behavior can win or remain CURRENT_UNDEFINED.
behavior_changes.target_behavior: Explicit user direct/proxy policy is evaluated after safety and Fake-IP, before China/default policy.
behavior_changes.motivation: Make explicit user intent visible without allowing the adapter to decide precedence.
behavior_changes.safety_impact: Must not override DNS, control, self, TUN, node, local, or reply safety.
behavior_changes.compatibility_impact: May change China direct/proxy outcomes for existing users.
behavior_changes.legacy_impact: Legacy rule precedence may differ and requires separate validation.
behavior_changes.modern_impact: Modern classifier would need explicit policy facts.
behavior_changes.rollback_risk: Medium; revert profile or renderer mapping without changing state schema.
behavior_changes.recommendation_reason: Current production mapping is incomplete and user policy compatibility needs explicit review.

behavior_changes.current_behavior: Exact modern production insertion already places NODE_ENDPOINT before CUSTOM_ACCESS in the final chain.
behavior_changes.target_behavior: NODE_ENDPOINT safety precedes ordinary access policy.
behavior_changes.motivation: Record the verified current underlay ordering without changing production.
behavior_changes.safety_impact: The current ordering reduces proxy underlay loop risk.
behavior_changes.compatibility_impact: No packet behavior change remains for the audited modern NODE+ACCESS overlap.
behavior_changes.legacy_impact: Legacy ACL order must be checked independently.
behavior_changes.modern_impact: Modern set order must preserve node safety.
behavior_changes.packet_path_impact: NO_PACKET_BEHAVIOR_CHANGE for the audited modern current path; baseline correction only.
behavior_changes.rollback_risk: Low; development oracle correction with production unchanged.
behavior_changes.recommendation_reason: Exact production evidence already shows the safe ordering; retain as a recorded baseline and keep approval status explicit.

behavior_changes.current_behavior: IPv6 control precedence is represented by the current family-specific rule position.
behavior_changes.target_behavior: IPv6 control protocols are protected before user routing policy.
behavior_changes.motivation: Preserve DHCPv6, neighbor discovery, router discovery, and ICMPv6 error delivery.
behavior_changes.safety_impact: SAFETY_FIX for native IPv6 control traffic.
behavior_changes.compatibility_impact: Control packets that were previously classified by policy will bypass.
behavior_changes.legacy_impact: Requires family-specific legacy verification; no IPv4 mirror is implied.
behavior_changes.packet_path_impact: PACKET_BEHAVIOR_CHANGE for protected IPv6 control packets.
behavior_changes.recommendation_reason: Native IPv6 control is required for stable network operation and has explicit family scope.

behavior_changes.current_behavior: IPv4 TUN ingress returns; IPv6 TUN ingress remains a documented current gap.
behavior_changes.target_behavior: TUN ingress returns consistently for both families.
behavior_changes.motivation: Prevent IPv6 proxy underlay re-entry and policy reclassification.
behavior_changes.compatibility_impact: IPv6 TUN traffic may stop following the current default proxy path.
behavior_changes.legacy_impact: Legacy TUN/TProxy behavior requires separate family testing.
behavior_changes.modern_impact: Modern renderer must preserve the same semantic return.
behavior_changes.rollback_risk: Medium; a wrong owner or interface detector can affect proxy return traffic.
behavior_changes.recommendation_reason: The current family asymmetry is a known loop-prevention gap; rollout must remain separately gated.

behavior_changes.current_behavior: NODE_ENDPOINT may win over SELF_TRAFFIC in the current diagnostic reason.
behavior_changes.target_behavior: SELF_TRAFFIC may win for diagnostics while retaining BYPASS outcome.
behavior_changes.motivation: Preserve owner diagnostics without changing underlay action.
behavior_changes.recommendation_reason: Outcome remains BYPASS; approve only after diagnostic consumers are checked.

behavior_changes.current_behavior: CHINA_PASS is recorded but current behavior can fall through to DEFAULT_POLICY.
behavior_changes.target_behavior: CHINA_PASS receives an explicit diagnostic reason while retaining proxy/fall-through intent.
behavior_changes.motivation: Make pass overrides explainable without conflating them with China direct.
behavior_changes.compatibility_impact: Reason and trace output change; overlapping explicit policies may also change under BC-01.
behavior_changes.legacy_impact: Renderer must preserve current pass behavior until separately approved.
behavior_changes.packet_path_impact: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY for the isolated China-pass case.
behavior_changes.rollback_risk: Low when kept as reason-only change.
behavior_changes.recommendation_reason: The isolated decision remains proxy/fall-through; keep packet behavior unchanged.

behavior_changes.current_behavior: Modern access-deny configuration can appear as return/bypass while legacy capability may deny.
behavior_changes.target_behavior: ACCESS_DENY is explicit and backend capability is reported rather than inferred.
behavior_changes.motivation: Avoid silently claiming equivalent deny semantics across backends.
behavior_changes.safety_impact: Potentially significant; a mistaken deny or bypass changes reachability.
behavior_changes.compatibility_impact: High; existing ACL users may depend on either behavior.
behavior_changes.legacy_impact: Legacy deny capability may be stronger than modern current behavior.
behavior_changes.modern_impact: Requires evidence whether current return is intentional or a mismatch.
behavior_changes.rollback_risk: High without device evidence and explicit policy approval.
behavior_changes.recommendation_reason: Current intent is ambiguous; do not normalize modern and legacy deny behavior by assumption.

single_source_of_truth.rule: Renderer consumes normalized semantic state and must not independently reinterpret configuration or runtime sources.

golden_compatibility.rule: The specification and executable model must drift together only through a failing validation test.
